title: Accutane online: iPLEDGE rules, dermatologists, and costs - FutureClinic
summary: This Accutane online guide compares Honeydew and a $40 FutureClinic visit, iPLEDGE rules, and how a dermatologist can prescribe if it's right for you.
body_markdown:
## What online Accutane costs: FutureClinic vs Honeydew, Clear Health, and Miiskin


FutureClinic has no subscription required. Pay $40 for the best-fit doctor, or pick a dermatologist at their listed price, typically $20 to $100. Most FutureClinic doctors also offer an optional membership, typically $25 to $100 a month for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time (a one-off visit fee counts toward a membership if you join after).


For a stable non-isotretinoin medicine, a low[monthly fee](https://futureclinic.com/blog/telehealth-subscriptions-vs-paying-a-doctor-per-visit-yearly-cost) elsewhere assumes you stay subscribed to keep getting refills. On FutureClinic, your doctor can prescribe several months of a stable medicine at once when they judge it safe, to the pharmacy you choose (including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door), with a cash discount coupon or through your pharmacy insurance, plus prior authorization help. On Cost Plus Drugs as of October 2026 (plus $5.25 shipping), tretinoin 0.025% cream (20 g) is $14.17 and doxycycline hyclate 100 mg (30 tablets) is $6.60.


Competitor isotretinoin prices as of October 2026:


-


**Honeydew:** Free first consult; Accutane Membership $64/month (three-month minimum; $26 penalty), $57/month ($229/four months), or $50/month annually ($299/year plus $25/month). Medicine and labs extra: cash $30 to $50/box (FAQ: ~$65), or as low as $0 with insurance.


-


**Clear Health:** Standard Accutane $59/month or $275/six months (includes month one's medicine); micro-dose $59 month one then $115/month with medicine; topical Isoclear needs no iPLEDGE.


-


**Miiskin:** $69/month subscription; medicine, labs, and pregnancy tests extra.


Where another service suits you better: Honeydew offers video visits within 48 hours and a $25/month Basic annual plan ($299/year) for non-Accutane care, and Clear Health and Honeydew offer compounded formulas or bundled micro-dose pricing. On FutureClinic, your doctor replies typically within a few hours, almost always the same day or the next, because real care takes hours, not seconds.


Before choosing a program, ask yourself: did you want an online Accutane subscription and its multi-month commitments, or did you simply want a dermatologist of your own to manage your course? When all you wanted was an expert physician with nothing attached, FutureClinic lets you message that same doctor with no subscription required.

## Messaging a FutureClinic dermatologist about Accutane from your AI app


First, an AI assistant trained by your doctor asks about your history, medicines, past treatments, and photos (AAD tips: remove makeup, use bright natural light and a plain background with filters off, and take overview, comparison, and close-up shots). You confirm a summary before the doctor sees it.


At FutureClinic, we believe AI is a tool for doctors, and the doctor is in charge of every case. Most health problems have nuance and need one-to-one attention, and only an expert knows when an AI has made a mistake or is heading to the wrong answer. FutureClinic's AI works behind the scenes like a chief resident and never gives medical advice by itself.


FutureClinic works from the AI app you already use, including ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and Instinct. Start on futureclinic.com in any browser, or visit[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) to start from your AI app, where you can also use this setup line:


> ` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C., with a doctor licensed in your state: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If you don't see your state, try anyway.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
